label: GO: repeating a1 after a rewarded a1 trial (early/mid episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO, only when the previous trial was rewarded, its choice was a1 (almost always via the common a1->S1 transition), and the agent is about to choose a1 again (win-stay on a1; policy logit a1-a2 > 8 holds 94% of mass). The predicate captures ~100% of activation mass, but precision is only ~0.37: many such GO steps stay below threshold. Magnitude builds over consecutive rewarded a1 trials within a run (activations ramp up across the window, e.g. 0.15 -> 0.45 -> 0.63), and the unit is strongly gated by episode time: rare before trial 10, highest at trials 10-60, falling off by 70-79, and essentially never active after trial 80. Restricting to trials 10-69 plus choice>8 raises F1 to ~0.63 at a cost in recall. Never fires at D1 or D2, after an unrewarded trial, after an a2 choice, or when the agent picks a2. Recorded the predicate uses model_act (the agent own argmax at GO, observable) instead of the future action; the two score the same.
